dct_title_s: Zoning Overlay Districts, Cambridge, Massachusetts, December 2006
dct_description_sm: Abstract: This polygon layer contains the zoning overlay districts in the City of Cambridge that set out additional or alternative zoning regulations to an area's base zoning restrictions. Overlay districts typically govern aesthetic and physical features, rather than restricting use.
Purpose: Created as part of Cambridge's Zoning Ordinance to delineate zoning overlay district boundaries.
